title: DuckMoo Nexus | Azeroth Stock Exchange
description: Observed prices, supply and listings. API listing disappearance is not a confirmed sale. Auctionator buckets are daily extrema, TSM sale rates are regional estimates.

list.name: account
list.label: Account
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT namespace FROM nexus.imports UNION SELECT DISTINCT namespace FROM nexus.source_snapshots

panels.title: Auctionator daily price range for selected item
panels.description: Bucket start is local Jan 1 2020 epoch plus elapsed 86400-second days; no exact scan time claimed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT observed_at AS time,scope||' low' AS metric,(metrics->>'lowest_low')::numeric/10000.0 AS value FROM nexus.market_observations WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND item_key IN (${item:sqlstring},'i:'||${item:sqlstring}) AND time_precision='day_bucket' AND $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY 1

SELECT observed_at AS time,scope AS metric,(metrics->>'highest_quantity')::numeric AS value FROM nexus.market_observations WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND item_key IN (${item:sqlstring},'i:'||${item:sqlstring}) AND time_precision='day_bucket' AND $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY 1

SELECT observed_at AS time,scope AS metric,(metrics->>'min_buyout')::numeric/10000.0 AS value FROM nexus.market_observations WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND item_key IN (${item:sqlstring},'i:'||${item:sqlstring}) AND metrics ? 'min_buyout' AND $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Selected item: observations across markets
panels.description: Different source scopes, day buckets and variants must not be treated as synchronized arbitrage quotes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT scope,source,observed_at,time_precision,metrics,quality FROM nexus.market_observations WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND item_key IN (${item:sqlstring},'i:'||${item:sqlstring}) ORDER BY observed_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

panels.title: Source refresh and API poll health
panels.description: Fetch time and upstream Last-Modified are distinct. Empty until API credentials and collection are configured.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.region,p.scope,p.fetched_at,p.status,s.source_modified_at,s.auction_count FROM nexus.api_polls p LEFT JOIN nexus.api_snapshots s ON s.id=p.snapshot_id ORDER BY p.fetched_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Blizzard observed listing supply
panels.description: Uses source Last-Modified when present, otherwise fetch time. Counts listings, not sales.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(s.source_modified_at,s.fetched_at) AS time,s.scope AS metric,sum(a.quantity) AS value FROM nexus.api_snapshots s JOIN nexus.auction_listings a ON a.snapshot_id=s.id WHERE a.item_id::text=regexp_replace(${item:sqlstring},'^i:','') AND $__timeFilter(s.fetched_at) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Confirmed personal transactions for selected item

targets.rawSql: SELECT occurred_at,character,realm,category,subtype,item_name,quantity,invoice_value_copper/10000.0 AS invoice_g FROM nexus.transactions WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND item_id::text=regexp_replace(${item:sqlstring},'^i:','') AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Crafting observation coverage
panels.description: Operation previews and outcomes are not completed crafts or realized profits.

targets.rawSql: SELECT kind,count(*) AS observations,max(observed_at) AS newest FROM nexus.crafting_observations WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} GROUP BY kind
